mainEntity.name: Can I still have composite bonding if I have a deep bite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, composite bonding is still possible with a deep bite, but requires careful treatment planning. Your dentist may recommend bite adjustment, orthodontic treatment, or specific restoration designs to improve success rates. The key is addressing the underlying bite issues to create more favourable conditions for long-term bonding success.

mainEntity.name: How long will composite bonding last with a deep bite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Composite bonding longevity in deep bite patients varies depending on the severity of the bite issue and treatment approach. With proper planning and bite management, bonded restorations can last 5-10 years. However, without addressing underlying bite problems, restorations may require more frequent repair or replacement due to excessive wear or debonding.

mainEntity.name: Will fixing my deep bite improve my bonding results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Correcting deep bite patterns before or alongside composite bonding typically improves treatment outcomes significantly. Orthodontic correction creates more balanced bite forces, reducing stress on bonded restorations and improving their longevity. This approach often provides better aesthetic and functional results in the long term.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my deep bite is affecting my bonding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs include frequent chipping or debonding of composite restorations, excessive wear of bonded surfaces, sensitivity in bonded teeth, or visible damage to restoration edges. If you notice these issues, professional assessment can determine whether bite forces are contributing to restoration problems.

mainEntity.name: Do I need orthodontics before composite bonding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orthodontic treatment isn't always necessary before composite bonding, but may be recommended in severe deep bite cases. Your dentist will assess your individual situation, considering factors like bite severity, restoration goals, and long-term treatment success. Sometimes minor bite adjustments are sufficient, whilst other cases benefit from comprehensive orthodontic correction.

mainEntity.name: Can night guards help protect bonding with a deep bite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, custom night guards can be particularly beneficial for deep bite patients with composite bonding. They help distribute bite forces more evenly and protect against nocturnal grinding or clenching that may be exacerbated by deep bite patterns. This protective approach can significantly extend restoration longevity.
